props.name: chrome
props.description: `field` opts this Select into the field metric axis, so it reads as a form field rather than a button. Defaults to `default`, leaving every existing Select untouched.

props.name: actionsRef
props.description: A ref to imperative actions. - `unmount`: Manually unmounts the select. Call this after any externally controlled closing animation finishes.

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: Provides a hint to the browser for autofill.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the select popup is initially open.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The uncontrolled value of the select when it's initially rendered.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: form
props.description: Identifies the form that owns the hidden input. Useful when the select is rendered outside the form.

props.name: highlightItemOnHover
props.description: Whether moving the pointer over items should highlight them. Disabling this prop allows CSS `:hover` to be differentiated from the `:focus` (`data-highlighted`) state.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the Select.

props.name: inputRef
props.type: ((instance: HTMLInputElement | null) => void | (() => void | { [UNDEFINED_VOID_ONLY]: never; }) | DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES[keyof DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES]) | RefObject<HTMLInputElement | null>
props.description: A ref to access the hidden input element.

props.name: isItemEqualToValue
props.description: Custom comparison logic used to determine if a select item value matches the current selected value. Useful when item values are objects without matching referentially. Defaults to `Object.is` comparison.

props.name: items
props.type: readonly Group<any>[] | Record<string, ReactNode> | readonly { label: React.ReactNode; value: any; }[]
props.description: Data structure of the items rendered in the select popup. When specified, `<Select.Value>` renders the label of the selected item instead of the raw value.

props.name: itemToStringLabel
props.description: When the item values are objects (`<Select.Item value={object}>`), this function converts the object value to a string representation for display in the trigger. If the shape of the object is `{ value, label }`, the label will be used automatically without needing to specify this prop.

props.name: itemToStringValue
props.description: When the item values are objects (`<Select.Item value={object}>`), this function converts the object value to a string representation for form submission. If the shape of the object is `{ value, label }`, the value will be used automatically without needing to specify this prop.

props.name: modal
props.description: Determines if the select enters a modal state when open. - `true`: user interaction is limited to the select: document page scroll is locked and pointer interactions on outside elements are disabled. - `false`: user interaction with the rest of the document is allowed.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether multiple items can be selected.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the select popup is opened or closed.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: Event handler called after any animations complete when the select popup is opened or closed.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: (value: (Multiple extends true ? Value[] : Value) | (Multiple extends true ? never : null), eventDetails: SelectRootChangeEventDetails) => void
props.description: Event handler called when the value of the select changes.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the select popup is currently open.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to choose a different option from the select popup.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must choose a value before submitting a form.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the select. Use when controlled.

name: SelectActionItem
description: An action row inside the list, placed last after a `SelectSeparator`, such as Show All. It is reached by the arrow keys and typeahead like an item, but pressing it runs `onAction` instead of choosing a value. It is an option to assistive technology, so it takes no `aria-expanded`: its label says what it does.

props.name: closeOnAction
props.description: Whether pressing the row closes the list. Off by default: a list action such as Show All changes what the list shows, so the list stays open.

props.name: label
props.description: The text typeahead matches, when the row's content is not plain text.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Runs when the row is pressed: clicked, or Enter or Space while it is highlighted. The row never becomes the Select's value and never calls `onValueChange`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `true` if the rendered element is a native button.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Additional space to maintain from the edge of the collision boundary: 8px from the window's edge, and 8px from a frame inset where a shell keeps one. A value you pass is kept as it is.

props.name: align
props.description: How to align the popup relative to the specified side.

props.name: alignItemWithTrigger
props.description: Whether the positioner overlaps the trigger so the selected item's text is aligned with the trigger's value text. This only applies to mouse input and is automatically disabled if there is not enough space.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Additional offset along the alignment axis in pixels. Also accepts a function that returns the offset to read the dimensions of the anchor and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

props.name: anchor
props.type: Element | VirtualElement | RefObject<Element | null> | (() => Element | VirtualElement | null)
props.description: An element to position the popup against. By default, the popup will be positioned against the trigger.

props.name: arrowPadding
props.description: Minimum distance to maintain between the arrow and the edges of the popup.

props.name: collisionAvoidance
props.description: Determines how to handle collisions when positioning the popup.

props.name: collisionBoundary
props.description: An element or a rectangle that delimits the area that the popup is confined to.

props.name: disableAnchorTracking
props.description: Whether to disable the popup from tracking any layout shift of its positioning anchor.

props.name: finalFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: InteractionType) => boolean | HTMLElement | null | void)
props.description: Determines the element to focus when the select popup is closed.

props.name: positionMethod
props.description: Determines which CSS `position` property to use.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the anchor element to align the popup against. May automatically change to avoid collisions.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance between the anchor and the popup in pixels. Also accepts a function that returns the distance to read the dimensions of the anchor and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Whether to maintain the popup in the viewport after the anchor element was scrolled out of view.
